description.value: Red Arrow Brewing Company is a craft brewery established in 2015 in the Cowichan Valley, operating a 35-seat taproom and a 65-seat outdoor patio at its Duncan location on Chaster Road. The brewery pours 12 of its own beers on tap alongside craft cocktails, local wines, and non-alcoholic options, all backed by a full-service food menu. The property also features a Sports Court used for concerts, fundraisers, and community events, giving it a strong community-hub character beyond a typical taproom.
